objections.claim: At candidate sha256:b99381f2cb15a68126cd4208b2fa412dcad7772fa0c74d4a8ef324880f0bb817, the added post-merge re-enumeration does not close the same-run race. A custody, App-permission, deploy-key, membership, or environment-policy change after attestation issuance can invalidate eligibility before the merge PUT, yet the controller still mutates protected main. Detecting the drift afterward and opening a revert PR is quarantine/recovery, not fail-closed pre-merge enforcement; the unauthorized merge and any resulting effects have already occurred, and the revert itself awaits another merge. Require a platform-enforced interval preventing every attested surface from changing through the mutation, or an atomic/serialized privileged revalidation-and-merge mechanism. The regression must prove each between-attestation-and-PUT mutation prevents the original merge, not merely that post-run detection fires.
